Product families

Motors by duty and efficiency.

Efficiency classes IE2, IE3 and IE4, and application-specific motors for demanding duties.

01Standard efficiency classesIE2 · IE3 · IE4

General-performance induction motors in IE2, IE3 and IE4 efficiency classes. They optimise energy consumption while reducing vibration and noise.

Brands ABB, CG, Innomotics, Hindustan

02FlameproofIE2 · IE3

Flameproof motors in IE2 and IE3, including TEFC flameproof. CG lists a flameproof range with ATEX certification.

Brands ABB, CG, Hindustan

03Crane dutyIncl. slip-ring

Crane duty motors, including slip-ring crane duty motors.

Brands ABB, CG, WEG

04Brake motorsIntegrated brake

Brake motors for applications that need controlled stopping. Innomotics lists the 1LE7 brake motor in 71–225 frame (IE2).

Brands ABB, CG, Innomotics, Hindustan

05Smoke ventingSmoke extraction

Smoke venting and smoke extraction motors.

Brands ABB, CG

06Cooling tower & dual speedHindustan range

Cooling tower motors and dual speed motors from Hindustan Electric Motors.

Brands Hindustan

07Slip ring, aluminium & fan cooledSpecialist

Slip-ring motors and the IE2 aluminium series from CG. Innomotics 1PQ8 series (separately fan cooled).

Brands CG, Innomotics

08Industrial fansFans

Industrial fans appear in the CG and WEG ranges.

Brands CG, WEG
